title: AppContext: Differentiating Malicious and Benign Mobile App Behaviors Using Context
authors: Wei Yang; Xusheng Xiao; Benjamin Andow; Sihan Li; Tao Xie; William Enck
research_question: 能否用触发敏感行为的事件和条件区分恶意与良性行为
input_information: DEX; entry points; ICC; sensitive calls; conditions
core_mechanism: 扩展调用图连接 ICC；reduced inter-procedural CFG；activation event 与 guarding/context factors；SVM 分类
main_result: 识别192个恶意应用；precision 87.7%; recall 95%
limitations: 不建模第一方/第三方责任边界；输出是行为/应用分类而非选择性纠错
relation_to_care_droid: 直接覆盖 activation+guard+敏感行为，是最强机制冲突之一
novelty_conflict: HIGH: 覆盖上下文变量但不覆盖 ownership-boundary deconvolution

title: FlowCog: Context-aware Semantics Extraction and Analysis of Information Flow Leaks in Android Apps
authors: Xiang Pan; Yinzhi Cao; Xuechao Du; Boyuan He; Gan Fang; Rui Shao; Yan Chen
research_question: 具体信息流是否被相关 UI 语义充分解释
input_information: FlowDroid flows; control/data/view dependencies; layouts; text; images
core_mechanism: 从 flow 的 activation/guard 经依赖定位相关 views；NLP 判断 flow 与 UI 语义相关性
main_result: precision 90.1%; recall 93.1%
limitations: 依赖精细 taint/data-flow；对 native/WebView 不可见；无 ownership-boundary 责任单元
relation_to_care_droid: 直接覆盖具体行为的 UI 正当化
novelty_conflict: HIGH: benign justification 已覆盖；未做共享库边界去卷积

title: Checking App Behavior Against App Descriptions (CHABADA)
authors: Alessandra Gorla; Ilaria Tavecchia; Florian Gross; Andreas Zeller
research_question: 实现行为是否偏离商店描述所暗示的功能
input_information: Google Play descriptions; sensitive API usage
core_mechanism: 描述主题聚类；在同主题簇中检测 API 使用异常
main_result: 标记56%的新型恶意样本
limitations: app-level 描述与 API 异常；不能天然给出 FP/FN 两侧有符号方向；依赖商店文本
relation_to_care_droid: 说明不一致证据不同于类别方向
novelty_conflict: MEDIUM: 上下文/行为一致性重叠但分析单元不同

title: TriggerScope: Towards Detecting Logic Bombs in Android Applications
authors: Christopher Fratantonio; Antonio Bianchi; William Robertson; Engin Kirda; Christopher Kruegel; Giovanni Vigna
research_question: 能否发现由时间/位置/SMS等窄条件保护的敏感行为
input_information: DEX; CFG; symbolic values; sensitive APIs
core_mechanism: 符号值建模；基本块和路径谓词恢复/最小化；跨过程控制依赖；trigger predicate 分类
main_result: 报告0.38% false positive；对其恶意集100%检测
limitations: 谓词恢复成本与敏感方法过滤高度相关；不处理 ownership/UI justification
relation_to_care_droid: 覆盖候选 boundary guard 的实现机制，但不是责任归因
novelty_conflict: MEDIUM-HIGH: guard/predicate 已有，boundary unit 未有

title: On The (In)Effectiveness of Static Logic Bomb Detector for Android Apps
authors: Jordan Samhi; Alexandre Bartel
research_question: TriggerScope 类方法大规模使用时的精度与覆盖代价是什么
input_information: TSOpen; 500k+ apps; sensitive-method filters
core_mechanism: 开源复现并审计 TriggerScope；测量过滤、误报和覆盖关系
main_result: 约0.3%误报需要过滤约90%敏感方法
limitations: 极低误报可由选择性删除制造；不能把剩余子集性能外推到全量
